title: The night's second half: the day in three phases, and RC2's parts taking shape
headline: The team worked through the night on RC2's inputs while NS1 waits for you. The historian put your account of why the team stopped beside the record, mapped the day into three phases (you building by hand to about 04:00, the machine alone until 14:00, both together after) and dug out the agents' own exchanges. The researcher counted wakes by trigger; the storyteller drafted the maps article; the publisher has footnotes and a QR test sheet; the developer and designer pushed the reader and the visuals further.
